questions.prompt: Why can an ML system degrade while its software still returns successful responses?

options.label: Learned behavior can worsen when the production data distribution changes.
Successful responses prove model behavior is unchanged.

questions.explanation: Statistical behavior can degrade silently even when the serving path executes correctly.

questions.prompt: Which latency requirement is operationally testable?

options.label: p95 is under 120 ms at 50 requests per second on the target hardware.

questions.explanation: A testable requirement names the metric, percentile, threshold, load, and environment.

questions.prompt: What is usually the best first experiment for a risky system assumption?

options.label: The cheapest valid experiment that can change the decision.

questions.explanation: Early experiments should maximize decision-relevant information per unit of time and cost.
